Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Fold's Recurring-tab empty state - an arc of twelve coin dots that flip from gray to dark navy in a staggered traveling sequence, like payments landing on a schedule, looping endlessly.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light "Recurring" screen: an arc (upper semicircle) of ~12 coin dots center stage, headline "Avoid missed payments & unwanted subscriptions", subcopy about auto-tracking recurring transactions, a "Coming soon" pill, standard tab bar.

## Motion spec
Pattern: staggered 3D coin flip wave around an arc.
- Each coin flips on its vertical axis (rotateY 0 -> 180, ~350ms, ease-in-out), showing a gray face then a navy face - a wave that travels clockwise around the arc.
- Stagger: ~80ms between neighboring coins, so two or three are mid-flip at any moment; after the last coin, the wave holds ~600ms, then all fade back to gray (~400ms) and the loop restarts.
- Coins have a subtle 3D thickness - mid-flip they read as thin ellipses, not flat color swaps.
- Headline, pill, and tab bar stay static.

## Calibration
- The wave travels in ONE consistent direction each loop.
- The flip must show an edge-on moment (scaleX near 0) - crossfading two circles kills the coin read.

## Reduced motion
Coins pulse opacity in the same staggered wave.

## Don't miss
- The arc opens downward (semicircle over the headline), coins evenly spaced.
- Loop gap (~600ms hold) keeps it calm, not frantic.
